text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a thin-slice swap for engine bundle engine-v4.2-quant-rc3 tonight, targeting quiet window 03:00 UTC. Thermal sim flagged a small cluster in eu-west that sits ~10% higher memory pressure.
jun: thanks — is this the bundle that includes the new matmul kernel + int8 quant patch?
carl: yes, it pulls kernel-matmul-v2 + quant-rc3 bindings. we've validated perf locally but not full thermal runs on eu-west.
manika (ops-bot): @maya tagging infra: thermal-sim alerts earlier today on a subset of g4dn-equivalents.
maya: correct — that's why i want to keep thin-slice small and have an explicit bailout plan. proposing: 5% traffic for 30m, check CPU/GPU temp, eviction rate, and servable 99p latency. if any metric crosses threshold -> immediate pin + rollback.
jun: can you spell thresholds? need clear gates for deploybot to act automatically.
maya: suggested gates: GPU temp delta > 8C vs baseline, p99 latency increase > 25% absolute, OOMs or eviction_rate > 0.5% in-slice. also 2 or more region anomalies within 10m -> rollback.
carl: add a guard for kv-cache errors — last time a mismatch spiked tail latencies without obvious thermals. so include cache-error-rate > 0.2%.
anika: +1 on cache check. Also we should pre-annotate release notes: note kernel matmul changes, quant int8 tone tuning, and the fallback compatibility note (will revert to int16 variant on rollback).
sre-oncall: i'll standby for the window. if deploybot signals bail, i'll cut the pin and run rollback ops. recommend a 10m manual hold before full rollback to let quick fixes breathe?
maya: i'd rather automatic rollback so we avoid traffic flapping. deploybot should pin immediately and roll traffic back to engine-v4.1.8 (current stable). manual follow-up allowed.
deploybot: deploy schedule accepted. executing thin-slice at 1719995400 (03:00 UTC). auto-bail criteria: {"gpu_temp_delta_c":8, "p99_latency_pct":25, "oom_count":1, "eviction_pct":0.5, "cache_error_pct":0.2, "region_anom_count":2}. will pin and shift traffic to engine-v4.1.8 on trigger.
jun: can we also add a quick smokecheck step post-slice start? 5 replicate requests to chat & embed routes, assert exact-match sanity for known prompts.
anmika (ops-bot): smokecheck script: ```bash
./smoke.sh --bundle engine-v4.2-quant-rc3 --routes chat,embed --samples 5
```
carl: good. ensure we log the eval vectors to S3 location s3://redwood-ops/rollouts/1719993333/ for postmortem.
sre-oncall: i'll watch CloudWatch/Tracing; set me @sre-oncall if deploybot pins.
maya: release notes draft in #release-notes later today. action items: 1) deploybot schedule + gates (done), 2) upload smoke script and eval vectors (carl), 3) ops oncall ready (sre-oncall), 4) marketing blurb for canary (anika).
ops-bot: noting change window: 03:00-04:00 UTC, thin-slice 5% -> 30m, auto-bail rules set.
jun: if we see a small temp blip but no latency, do we still bail? might be noisy.
maya: only if sustained > 10m and exceeds thresholds. short transients are expected.
carl: final ask — add a transient hysteresis: require metric to breach for at least 3 consecutive 60s windows before trigger.
maya: ack. deploybot, incorporate hysteresis 3x60s.
deploybot: updated auto-bail with hysteresis. will post live status in this thread when slice starts. :rocket:
sre-oncall: thanks all — i'll be on pager and will escalate to eng-runtime #oncall if we need manual intervention.
anika: adding release note bullet: "engine-v4.2-quant-rc3: matmul v2 kernels; int8 quant tuning; thin-slice canary with auto-bail thresholds"
maya: perfect. see you at 03:00 UTC.
